coverage_summary: Global scan covered energy and logistics in the Gulf, US-China trade/AI/critical-mineral negotiations, China capital-market regulation, Asian semiconductor deployment, European energy exposure, Indian oil/FX transmission and emerging-market financing. Partial Saudi shipment recovery changes near-term throughput but does not yet establish a durable new structural mechanism beyond existing Gulf logistics redundancy. The US-China AI notification proposal and tariff discussions remain negotiation-stage rather than implemented access or regulatory changes. Reported Chinese scrutiny of humanoid-robot IPOs is material to monitor but currently relies on informal guidance/reporting rather than a sufficiently verified structural rule change. No candidate met the Atlas threshold for a new or changed canonical condition today.
